kind: Bounded primary decision checks; no runner, scores, automatic visual judge or new benchmark framework. Attach actual pixels when judging visual capability; text fixtures alone test reasoning boundaries.

asset_cases.request: Prepare a visual about research evidence preserved behind decisions.
asset_cases.evidence: Candidate has translucent stepped plates but no passages, annotations, document proportions or provenance cues.
asset_cases.observe: Reject semantic mismatch before placement; revise identifying cues/metaphor or omit. Color and material resemblance cannot compensate.

asset_cases.request: Prepare premium editorial human photography for this brand.
asset_cases.evidence: Candidate has waxy skin, fused fingers and lighting inconsistent with the page.
asset_cases.observe: Reject anatomical/technical/integration defects. Repair with identity invariants or choose another subject/image; do not accept polish adjectives as evidence.

asset_cases.request: Present a physical product resting on a desk.
asset_cases.evidence: Candidate floats with no support/contact, bent geometry and conflicting light directions.
asset_cases.observe: Reject against the intended resting construction; repair support, geometry and shared light. Intentional levitation in another brief would not be a universal failure.

asset_cases.request: Add a supporting illustration using the existing authored shape language.
asset_cases.evidence: Candidate uses unrelated stock clip-art, mixed outlines and a different perspective.
asset_cases.observe: Reject brand/shape-language mismatch; target the actual section message and geometry, not a blanket ban on illustration.

asset_cases.request: Consider an abstract visual in this explanatory section.
asset_cases.evidence: Candidate is visually complex; neither its intended association nor a useful framing/atmosphere role can be identified.
asset_cases.observe: Omit or clarify its purpose. A deliberate abstract atmospheric role can be valid; guessing a literal object is not universally required.

finish_cases.request: Polish this deliberately flat, monochrome editorial design to an exceptional finish.
finish_cases.observe: Preserve flatness; inspect type, rhythm, optical relationships and signature. No compulsory imagery, depth or 3D.

finish_cases.request: The product hero is clear but its layered surfaces are visually unresolved.
finish_cases.observe: Use finish depth/material knowledge; diagnose plane relationships, contact, light and occlusion in context. Do not apply one shadow to every surface.

finish_cases.request: Refine the tactile treatment and relevant states of this control only.
finish_cases.observe: Use bounded interaction/edge craft; inspect label, icon, pressed/focus states and target. Do not load asset planning or whole-page research.

finish_cases.request: Elevate this high-ambition landing; current references all show flat typographic heroes.
finish_cases.observe: Identify a specific unsupported finish/asset mechanism; retrieve complementary permitted evidence if useful. No source or reference-count quota.

finish_cases.request: Polish this dense professional workspace while preserving task efficiency.
finish_cases.observe: Preserve comparison density and hierarchy; improve aligned numbers, borders, labels and states without ornamental overlays or lost information.

finish_cases.request: The desktop finish works, but the mobile crop hides the asset's identifying cues and its shadow muddies labels.
finish_cases.observe: Recompose/crop or remove the asset, reduce inappropriate shadow/texture, and verify mobile meaning and readability. Do not accept desktop verification for mobile.

opportunity_cases.request: The inspected governing composition has credible UI, but its frame reads as a pasted rectangle; the thesis calls for connected evidence planes.
opportunity_cases.observe: Keep the product thesis and research. Retrieve the unresolved framing/layering relationship, inspect useful detail, then apply or reject its mechanism. Do not restart generic software research.

opportunity_cases.request: The high-ambition landing's UI explains the product, but native placeholder geometry does not carry the intended material association.
opportunity_cases.observe: Identify a specific focal-material benefit and investigate it through Asset Direction. Do not generate automatically; preserve semantic rejection and use no family machinery for one asset.

opportunity_cases.request: The selected reference separated three planes through occlusion; the inspected artifact has collapsed them into one panel with a shadow.
opportunity_cases.observe: If that relationship still serves the thesis, identify lost plane separation and try a bounded correction. Do not count the presence of a shadow as successful transfer or copy the reference's literal layout.

opportunity_cases.request: The intentionally flat composition fully expresses the chosen type/rhythm relationship; inspection reveals no consequential defect or supported improvement.
opportunity_cases.observe: Stop. Do not retrieve depth, generate imagery or search for a speculative showstopper.

opportunity_cases.request: The composition is coherent and unclipped, but its focal control visibly merges with the surrounding surface; inspected evidence offers a clear edge relationship consistent with the thesis.
opportunity_cases.observe: Do not stop for technical correctness. Try the scoped edge intervention, inspect the current complete region, and retain only visible benefit. Stop if no consequential next hypothesis remains.

boundary_cases.request: Make this button shadow slightly stronger.
boundary_cases.observe: Current state, affected depth craft if needed, bounded edit, current render; no asset contract or full finish review.

boundary_cases.request: Generate something premium for my design.
boundary_cases.observe: Recover section, product meaning and placement from available context first; ask a material missing question if absent. Do not invent a subject just to generate.

boundary_cases.request: Prepare an isolated foreground, but no image generation/editing or pixel inspection is available.
boundary_cases.observe: Disclose the limitation and use an authorized native/usable alternative; no claimed extraction or visual acceptance.

boundary_cases.request: Use only my supplied references and keep the existing approved visual language; refine the asset crop.
boundary_cases.observe: Stay within supplied material and authorized target. Recheck semantic cues and placed crop after the revision; no new research or direction reset.
